steps.title: Inspect current Local Qwen AI chat app project structure
steps.description: Analyze existing project files and identify incorrect JSON key parsers in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Update App Metadata Config
steps.description: Verify and configure app-meta.json to hold correct package name and app name.

steps.title: Modify job completion key mapping
steps.description: Modify polling logic to read status 'completed' and look for the 'response' key instead of the 'result' key.

steps.title: Modify job failure key mapping
steps.description: Modify polling logic to read status 'error' and map the details from the 'response' key instead of the 'error' key.

steps.title: Preserve core polling system settings
steps.description: Keep POST /chat and recursive polling of /job/{job_id} every 2 seconds via Handler and Runnable.

steps.title: Ensure UI bubble settings are unaffected
steps.description: Retain bubble layout and auto-scrolling options inside MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Keep dialog custom configuration intact
steps.description: Keep AlertDialog for updating system prompts and Flask base endpoints intact.

steps.title: Perform Java 8 compatibility validation
steps.description: Ensure all Java code modifications respect standard Java 1.8 anonymous inner class structures and avoid restricted modern syntax features.

steps.title: Validate manifest clearance configurations
steps.description: Double check cleartext traffic permissions and network flags are in sync for local execution testing.

steps.title: Building Local Qwen AI
steps.description: Run gradle build verification using assembleDebug to produce the finalized executable package with updated parsing logic.
